name: ROAD_SURFACE_TEST_KEEP_CLEAR_YELLOW_LONG
notes: TfNSW plan T6-228n (Roads & Maritime 2019 sheet, 1:10, text outlined): vehicle-mounted panel 1320 x 540, R30, yellow, no border (hairline outline). ROAD SURFACE TEST 100 C, top 20 (20 / 100), 106 / 276 / 55 / 484 / 48 / 244 / 107. KEEP CLEAR 120 D, top 380 (340 to the ridge, then 40 / 120 / 40), 155 / 42 / 376 / 64 / 486 / 42 / 155. Corner blocks 155 x 200 below the ridge at each end with 45-degree stripes from the stripe detail (27 black / 55 yellow / 55 black / 55 yellow / 59 black, measured square to the stripes from the upper outer corner), mirrored left and right and clipped to the rounded outline. Not drawn: the plan's 'window opening' (160 x 77 cut-out at 580 from the left, 140 from the top) and the dashed 'ridge' fold line at 340 — fabrication features of the roof-mounted panel, not part of the face artwork. The sheet draws both legend lines about 5 mm up and 5 mm right of its own chains (ROAD from 112, cap top 15; KEEP from 203, cap top 375): the stated figures are used, which is why the overlay shows an offset.
